description: This file implements a Netlink communication interface within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including serialization/deserialization of Netlink messages, socket communication, and debugging utilities.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Handles serialization, deserialization, and management of Netlink messages.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Manages socket communication for Netlink messages, including sending, receiving, and state changes.

methods.name: Netlink::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes Netlink message data into a stream buffer.

methods.name: Netlink::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream buffer into Netlink message fields.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message through the socket, with a specified wait time.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::Exchange
methods.description: Performs a request-response exchange of Netlink messages.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::SendData
methods.description: Prepares and retrieves data to send over the socket.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data from the socket.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::StateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications for the socket.
